text_block_list.text:
On our way back after going out with Fuji Kiseki
and running a quick errand……

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. Would you mind hanging out
with me for a bit after this?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Thank you! I knew
you'd say that, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Actually, I've already reserved a table♪
Come on, let's go!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Now, now, don't worry about it.
Leave the rest to me.

Where Fuji Kiseki brought me
was a planetarium.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"...It's fine, it's fine. Just relax.
Look, it seems like it's starting."

Leaning back in our seats for a while...
the two of us drifted across the sea of stars.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, did you enjoy yourself today?
Watching the dance of the stars once in a while
instead of Umamusume isn't so bad, is it?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
The Big Dipper—if you look closely at Ursa Major's tail,
it pops right up, super cute, right?♪
And then...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
The brilliant, profound shine of Spica...
was somewhat reminiscent of the light in your eyes, I suppose.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, as for the reason... let's just say
it's a little gift to bring you some soothing comfort.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, you're always working so hard for me,
aren't you? Just to show me that star of hope.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
That's why, in return,
I wanted to show you the stars too.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: "A humble starry sky you can enjoy even without traveling far. Consider it a token of my daily appreciation♪"

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Please continue to let me
be the guide to your dreams from here on out.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I want to be a miracle even to those closest to me,
after all. What kind of surprise would you like next?
choice_data_list: Next time, let's go stargazing and see the real thing.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I want to be a miracle even to those closest to me,
after all. What kind of surprise would you like next?
choice_data_list: Next time, let's go stargazing and see the real thing.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
A real star, huh... Can I take that to mean
you want to go on a space voyage with me?
choice_data_list: It's not that big of a deal...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, I wouldn't mind at all.
Not just for race expeditions, but even setting out on
an endless journey to the edge of the galaxy.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"I'm sure it would be wonderful. Weaving through
countless constellations, our conversation
blossoming along the way."

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"When that time comes, let's go to the ends of the earth.
It's a promise, my Campanella♪"

The stars were soothing, certainly. But even more than that,
Fuji Kiseki's sweet words provided the ultimate comfort.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...Haha.
Trainer, you can be pretty scary sometimes.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Even though you never studied acting,
you say things like that so naturally.
I really can't compete with you.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
But... with both you and me as entertainers,
that might make for quite a nice dynamic, too.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Let us move forward, inspiring dreams in one another.
An endless waltz together with you—just kidding♪

There are certainly stars in the sky. But the brightest star
was right beside me. That's how it felt.
